'''Rhylis''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] member of the [[Shoartu]] tribe of the [[Kerritamba Village]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. By the time following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], he and [[Hwruarca]] worked as arena guards at the [[Kerritamba Village Arena]].

==Biography==
A [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] by the name of Rhylis lived during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. He resided on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]] among his fellow Wookiees in the [[Shoartu]] tribe of the [[Kerritamba Village]]. By the time following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]]<ref name="ROTW" /> in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> he and a fellow female Wookiee by the name of [[Hwruarca]] had been assigned the role of arena guards, tasked with the responsibility of guarding the [[Kerritamba Village Arena]]. Hwruarca guarded the entrance to the arena, while Rhylis guarded the exit.<ref name="ROTW" />
{{GameMechanics|legends=1|Star Wars Galaxies: Rage of the Wookiees}}
Rhylis allowed at least one contestant to exit the arena, after they successfully defeated [[Shoartu Arena Champion]] [[Wirartu]] in combat.<ref name="ROTW" />
{{Endgame}}

==Equipment==
During his time as an arena guard, Rhylis wore a light brown [[Color/Legends|colored]] two-strap [[Bandolier/Legends|bandolier]] and a light brown decorated [[Belt/Legends|belt]].<ref name="ROTW" />

==Behind the scenes==
Rhylis was a non-player character in ''[[Star Wars Galaxies: Rage of the Wookiees]]'', a [[2005]] [[W:c:swg:Expansion|expansion pack]]<ref name="ROTW" /> to [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']], a [[Roleplaying game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]], prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="AED">{{GalaxiesAED}}</ref><ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Rhylis was featured in a [[W:c:swg:Quest|quest]] titled "[[W:c:swg:Arena Challenge: Face Wirartu|Arena Challenge: Face Wirartu]]," in which players were tasked with defeating Wirartu in [[W:c:swg:Combat|combat]]. Upon doing so, players had to speak with Rhylis in order to exit the arena.<ref name="ROTW" /> In the [[W:c:swg:Star Wars Galaxies|game's]] directory tree files and source data, Rhylis' name is listed as '''Bocashunk''' (an Arena Guardian).<ref name="TRE">''[[Star Wars Galaxies: Rage of the Wookiees]]'' directory tree files and source data</ref> However, this alternative name was not used in the game, and is therefore considered [[Canon|non-canon]] in [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]].<ref name="ROTW" />
